# Physics scenarios shared by ruststeve's tests/differential.rs and the one-off clojurecraft
# oracle that wrote expected.txt (clojurecraft.physics/step at be85a92).
#
#   scenario <name>
#   solid x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1 <top>          inclusive block range; top 1.0 full, under 1 a flat box
#   fluid x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1 <water|lava> <level>
#   start x y z <ground|air>               feet position, on the ground or not
#   ticks <n> <forward 0|1> <jump 0|1> <sneak 0|1> <yaw degrees>
#   end
# The first matching line answers a block; anything else is empty.

scenario flat-walk
solid -16 60 -16 16 63 16 1.0
start 0.5 64 0.5 ground
ticks 40 1 0 0 0
end

scenario wall
solid 0 64 3 0 65 3 1.0
solid -16 60 -16 16 63 16 1.0
start 0.5 64 0.5 ground
ticks 40 1 0 0 0
end

scenario jump-onto-block
solid -1 64 2 1 64 2 1.0
solid -16 60 -16 16 63 16 1.0
start 0.5 64 0.5 ground
ticks 5 1 0 0 0
ticks 12 1 1 0 0
ticks 25 1 0 0 0
end

scenario carpet
solid -1 64 2 1 64 2 0.0625
solid -16 60 -16 16 63 16 1.0
start 0.5 64 0.5 ground
ticks 40 1 0 0 0
end

scenario off-a-ledge
solid -16 60 -16 16 63 1 1.0
solid -16 52 2 16 55 16 1.0
start 0.5 64 0.5 ground
ticks 60 1 0 0 0
end

scenario sink-in-water
solid -8 54 -8 8 58 8 1.0
fluid -8 59 -8 8 66 8 water 0
start 0.5 63 0.5 air
ticks 60 0 0 0 0
end

scenario swim-up
solid -8 54 -8 8 58 8 1.0
fluid -8 59 -8 8 66 8 water 0
start 0.5 60 0.5 air
ticks 80 0 1 0 0
end

scenario sneak-down-in-water
solid -8 54 -8 8 58 8 1.0
fluid -8 59 -8 8 66 8 water 0
start 0.5 64 0.5 air
ticks 40 0 0 1 0
end

scenario bank-impulse
solid -8 64 3 8 64 10 1.0
solid -8 54 -8 8 63 10 1.0
fluid -8 59 -8 8 63 2 water 0
start 0.5 62.2 0.5 air
ticks 80 1 1 0 0
end

scenario flowing-water
solid -8 54 -8 8 58 8 1.0
fluid -8 59 -8 8 59 8 water 3
fluid -8 60 -8 8 63 8 water 8
start 0.5 61 0.5 air
ticks 50 1 0 0 30
end

scenario in-lava
solid -8 54 -8 8 58 8 1.0
fluid -8 59 -8 8 62 8 lava 0
start 0.5 60 0.5 air
ticks 30 1 0 0 0
ticks 30 1 1 0 90
end

scenario turning-walk
solid -32 60 -32 32 63 32 1.0
start 0.5 64 0.5 ground
ticks 20 1 0 0 0
ticks 20 1 0 0 45
ticks 20 1 0 0 90
ticks 20 1 0 0 -135
ticks 20 1 0 0 30.5
end

scenario held-jump-cooldown
solid -16 60 -16 16 63 16 1.0
start 0.5 64 0.5 ground
ticks 60 0 1 0 0
end
